data.description: Elevation allows elements to be lifted from the background. It can be defined by applying drop shadows or other visual cues, such as color and borders

shadows.description: Elevation using shadows reflects a spatial relationship by indicating separation from the background or allowing content to be scrolled under another element.

levels.name: Tw Ring Shadow
levels.description: Tailwind CSS ring shadow reset/placeholder value with zero blur and transparent color

levels.name: Shadow Default
levels.description: Standard shadow with 10% black opacity, 3px blur on first layer and 2px blur with -1px offset on second layer

levels.name: Shadow XS
levels.description: Extra small shadow with 5% black opacity and 2px blur for minimal elevation

levels.name: Shadow SM
levels.description: Small shadow identical to default with 10% black opacity and 3px blur

levels.name: Shadow MD
levels.description: Medium shadow with 10% black opacity, 6px blur on first layer and 4px blur on second

levels.name: Shadow LG
levels.description: Large shadow with 10% black opacity, 15px blur and 6px blur layers for prominent elevation

levels.name: Shadow XL
levels.description: Extra large shadow with 10% black opacity, 25px blur and 10px blur layers

levels.name: Shadow 2XL
levels.description: Maximum shadow with 25% black opacity and 50px blur for highest elevation

levels.name: Custom Glow Shadow
levels.description: Custom diffused glow shadow using HSL surface color at 25% opacity with 40px blur and 8px spread
